institutions.normalised: Parrochialis Ecclesia Beatae Mariae de Vinfiso

dates.text: tertio ious augusti anno a Nativitate Domini millesimo quadangentesimus quadratesimom prmo

data.summary: The Pope orders the Prepositus of St. Dalmatius in Turin to accept the resignation of Paulus Melgnesius from the parish of St. Mary of Vinfiso and to install Andreas Lomberdus in its possession, while reserving an annual pension of 40 florins for Paulus.
